translationRepairs: Jin defectors all said that their ruler, Emperor Xuanzong, was killing his own kin and growing more dissolute every day.
Jin defectors all said that their ruler Jing (Emperor Zhangzong) was killing his own kin and growing more dissolute every day.
璟 is the personal name of Emperor Zhangzong of Jin, not Xuanzong.
Earlier Prince Toqto had failed to take Mingzhou; he now sent Shi Tianying, who captured it.
Earlier Prince Daisun had failed to take Mingzhou; he now sent Shi Tianying, who captured it.
帶孫 is Daisun, not Toqto.

In the third month he crossed the river and returned to Wenxi County. Mortally ill, he called his brother Toqto and said, "I have served the state for nearly forty years in armor and at the front, campaigning east and west. I leave nothing undone except the capture of Bianjing. You must finish what I could not."

In the third month he crossed the river and returned to Wenxi County. Mortally ill, he called his brother Daisun and said, "I have served the state for nearly forty years in armor and at the front, campaigning east and west. I leave nothing undone except the capture of Bianjing. You must finish what I could not."
帶孫 is Daisun, not Toqto.
In the ninth month Prince Toqto besieged Li Quan at Yidu.
In the ninth month Prince Daisun besieged Li Quan at Yidu.
帶孫 is Daisun, not Toqto.
Tatartai was descended from Prince Toqto, the third son of Khun-temür.
Tatartai was descended from Prince Daisun, the third son of Khun-temür.
帶孫 is Daisun, not Toqto.
The clan's founding ancestor Borte Chino had made himself a power in the north through talent and arms.
The clan's founding ancestor Bodonchar had made himself a power in the north through talent and arms.
孛端察兒 is Bodonchar, not Börte Chino.
He was again ordered to defend the coastal frontier at Hangzhou.
He was again ordered to defend the frontier at Khangai.
杭海 is the Khangai region, not Hangzhou.

In the thirtieth year Chengzong led the imperial grandson to garrison the northern frontier; Usutai Temür accompanied the expedition and asked that the heir be entrusted with the former seal of the crown prince — and the edict granted his request.

In the thirtieth year Chengzong, as imperial grandson, garrisoned the northern frontier; Usutai Temür accompanied the expedition and asked that the heir be entrusted with the former seal of the crown prince — and the edict granted his request.
成宗以皇孫撫軍: Chengzong was himself the imperial grandson.

When Genghis Khan conquered Yan, Ögedei was regent; he heard that in Yanjing robbers were killing at will, targeting wealthy households and hauling off their goods while the authorities could not stop them.

When Genghis Khan conquered Yan, Tolui was regent; he heard that in Yanjing robbers were killing at will, targeting wealthy households and hauling off their goods while the authorities could not stop them.
睿宗 is Tolui, not Ögedei.
Ögedei had already entered Xingyuan from Xihe and marched out through Wu Pass into Tang and Deng; seeing his prolonged stalemate with the Jin, Ögedei Khan sent word to coordinate a joint advance.
Tolui had already entered Xingyuan from Xihe and marched out through Wu Pass into Tang and Deng; seeing his prolonged stalemate with the Jin, Ögedei Khan sent word to coordinate a joint advance.
睿宗 is Tolui, not Ögedei.
An edict summoned all forces to Jun Prefecture; snow fell for days; at Sanfeng Mountain Ögedei routed the Jin in a great victory.
An edict summoned all forces to Jun Prefecture; snow fell for days; at Sanfeng Mountain Tolui routed the Jin in a great victory.
睿宗 is Tolui, not Ögedei.
